events.title: Wheels Art show
events.description:
This Friday 10/23 6PM- 2AM join us for WHEELS, a car focused art and music exhibition featuring pieces by @art_by_3rent @she_paints_cars @somemedium @_itsboos @brookbanham 

We will have music in the usual @hizz.me back room while the gallery is going on until 11. Expect more experimental, ambient, IDM type of music. After 11 the club portion of the night starts as the gallery will closes we will get dancier but keeping it weird and experimental.

BYOB. 5$ tickets on RA but donation based door.
